items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: He was really my idol, one of my idols. My real heros were Ray Brown, Charlie Mingus.

ctx.x: And I remember the occasion, it came about that he was gonna go on the road. And I'd come by Mama's house and he was telling us about it, that he had an offer to go with Snookum Russell. Now, Snookum Russell had quite a name, so we knew that was quite a thing.
He was in that band the same time Ray Brown was...

Right, I was gonna say this. As a matter of fact, that's when I first heard Ray Brown's name come up to me. I'm not, still, in the music; I still wasn't into it. But Wes was talking about going on the road with this band and what a great musical venture it was for him.
